narrative.details:
Greetings, adventurer.

I have an assignment for you that is of the utmost priority. Please meet me in the mountains called Alterac, northwest of the village known as Strahnbrad. I will meet you at the cliff overlooking the Uplands valley.

Come alone, and tell no one.
narrative.objectives: Meet Elaadrin Evengale at the cliffs overlooking The Uplands in Alterac Mountains.
